goal.raw_text: Allows the Customer to update their account information and manage email notification preferences.

claims.content: Customer
The Customer navigates to the My Account page and selects an option to edit their personal information, addresses, payment methods, or email preferences.

trigger.raw_text: The Customer navigates to the My Account page and selects an option to edit their personal information, addresses, payment methods, or email preferences.

claims.content: The Customer navigates to the My Account page, which displays sections for My Information, My Billing Address, My Shipping Address, My Shipping Preferences, My Payment Methods, and My Email Preferences.
To update personal information (name, handle, email, phone, password), the Customer selects the EDIT button/link in the My Information section, which leads to the My Account Edit Page 1.

On the My Account Edit Page 1, the Customer enters their current password and fills in the new information fields (First Name, Last Name, Member Handle, E-mail Address, Phone, Password), then clicks SAVE CHANGES.
To update address information, the Customer selects the EDIT button/link in the My Billing Address or My Shipping Address section, which leads to the My Account Edit Page 2.
On the My Account Edit Page 2, the Customer enters the new billing and/or shipping address details (Address lines, Suite/Apt, City, State, Zip Code, Country) and clicks SAVE CHANGES.
To manage email notification preferences, the Customer selects the Email Preferences link or navigates to the relevant edit page (My Account Edit Page 4).
On the My Account Edit Page 4, the Customer checks or unchecks boxes for notifications (outbid, win auction, winnings shipped) and clicks SAVE CHANGES.
Upon saving changes or canceling on My Account Edit Page 1, the user will be returned to the My Account page.
Upon saving changes or canceling on My Account Edit Page 4, the user should be returned to the My Account page.
The user's account information (name, handle, email, phone, password) is updated in the system.
The user's email notification preferences (outbid, win auction, winnings shipped) are saved according to their selections.
The user is returned to the My Account page after successfully saving changes.
